sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate Lko.

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1. Heard SriVirendra Singh, learned counsel appearing for the applicant and learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State.
2. In view of the nature of the order proposed, notice to Opposite Party No.2 is hereby dispensed with.

3. The instant application under Section 483 Cr.P.C./529 B.N.S.S., 2023 has been filed inter-alia praying therein for the following relief:
"Issue a order or direction commanding to the opposite party no. 1/Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate 7th Lucknow to decide the trial Case no.-26701/2023 State V/S Kuldeep Katiyar & Ors arisen out of FIR no- 482/2021, U/S 498A, 323, 506, I.P.C.
and 3/4 D.P. Act Police Station -Krishna Nagar as soon as possible or expeditiously within a stipulated time, in the interest of justice"
4.

Learned counsel appearing for the applicant has submitted that the case for the offences punishable under Section 498-A, 323, 506, I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act had been filed by the applicant in Sukirti Katiyar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Judicial ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63942958/
1 the year 2021.

entities.text: Sukirti Katiyar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Judicial
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has further been submitted that since the year 2021, the said case is pending before the trial court and has yet not been decided.
5. Learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the State submits that this Court may provide that the case in question may be decided by the trial court expeditiously.

6. I have considered the arguments advanced by the learned counsel appearing for the applicant and I find that the case in question was filed way back in the year 2021 and since then, it is pending before the trial court.

7. In the aforesaid circumstances, this application is finally disposed of with direction to the learnedAdditional Chief Judicial Magistrate 7th, Lucknow to decide the Case No.-26701/2023 (State vs Kuldeep Katiyar & Ors), expeditiously.
